headline: All five wave-1 builders have landed and are committed, verified running at 60fps with 163 draw calls. The HUD now leads with projected finish, which fixed a readout that told flawless players they were failing. User-supplied Temple Run reference frames are in reference/ and turned the comparison into measurement: the track is about 2.5× too wide relative to the runner — a geometry ratio no camera move can fix.
